Bill.BriefDescription: Providing hunting and fishing opportunities to seriously ill children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to enhancing the department of fish and wildlife'sability to facilitate outdoor recreation opportunities for seriouslyill children; adding a new section to chapter 77.32 RCW; and creatinga new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In order to facilitate hunting and fishing opportunities forterminally or seriously ill children, the director may provide anylicenses, tags, permits, stamps, and fees without charge or atransaction fee. The director may only take such an action uponrequest by a nonprofit organization seeking to provide a hunting orfishing opportunity, or both, to one or more terminally or seriouslyill children who are each eighteen years old or younger. (2) The director may accept special permits or other specialhunting opportunities, including raffle tags, auction tags, andmultiple season opportunities from donors seeking to facilitate huntingopportunities for terminally or seriously ill children. The director p. 1 SB 6260shall distribute these donations pursuant to subsection (1) of thissection. (3) The director may take other actions consistent withfacilitating hunting and fishing opportunities for terminally orseriously ill children. These actions may include, but are not limitedto, entering into agreements with willing landowners, pursuant to RCW77.12.320, to provide hunting opportunities for terminally or seriouslyill children.
This act may be known and cited as theSenator Bob Oke memorial act.
